experiences.title: Restaurant, Cafe & Boutique Hotel Experience
experiences.subtitle: Located directly on the Yalıncak seafront in Ortahisar, Trabzon; offering an elegant atmosphere from morning sea-view breakfast to Italian fine dining and boutique hotel accommodation.
experiences.card1Text: Rich Turkish spread breakfast, fresh croissants, eggs benedict, healthy bowls, and artisan coffee right by the Black Sea shore in Yalıncak.
experiences.card2Text: Sourdough Neapolitan and Margherita pizzas baked in a stone oven, alongside daily handmade ravioli, tortellini, and authentic Italian pasta.
experiences.card3Text: Prime steak frites, grilled meats, fresh seasonal seafood, gourmet burgers, Mediterranean salads, vegan options, and Italian desserts.
experiences.card4Text: Stylish sea-view boutique hotel rooms in Yalıncak, Ortahisar—minutes away from Trabzon Airport and the Yomra–Kaşüstü coastal district.

reviews.title: Maison La Plage Reviews
reviews.rev1Text: A stunning seafront ambiance on Yalıncak beach in Trabzon. The stone-baked Margherita pizza and handmade ravioli are truly authentic Italian.
reviews.rev2Text: The sea-view breakfast is super fresh and beautifully presented. Easily the most refined cafe and restaurant in Ortahisar and Yalıncak.
reviews.rev3Text: Both the boutique hotel stay and the restaurant service were flawless. Being close to Trabzon Airport and Yomra is a huge plus.

faq.title: Visitor Guide & FAQ
faq.q1: Where is Maison La Plage located in Trabzon?
faq.a1: Maison La Plage is located right on the seafront at Yalıncak, Deniz 1 Nolu Sk No:5, 61080 Ortahisar/Trabzon, just minutes away from Trabzon Airport, Ortahisar center, and Yomra/Kaşüstü.
faq.q2: What are your breakfast and restaurant opening hours?
faq.a2: Our restaurant and cafe are open every day (Monday – Sunday) from 09:00 AM to 12:00 AM (midnight), serving breakfast, brunch, lunch, dinner, desserts, and specialty coffee.
faq.q3: What dishes are served on the Maison La Plage menu?
faq.a3: Our menu features sea-view Turkish and international breakfasts, stone-baked Neapolitan and Margherita pizzas, handmade ravioli and tortellini, steak frites, fresh seafood, vegan and Mediterranean salads, and artisan desserts.
faq.q4: How can I make a restaurant or boutique hotel reservation?
faq.a4: You can book online anytime via the 'Restaurant Reservations' and 'Hotel' links in the top navigation bar, or reach us directly by phone at +90 540 323 24 44.

contact.visitText: With its seafront location on Yalıncak beach in Ortahisar, Trabzon, stylish atmosphere, and curated menu, Maison La Plage awaits guests for sea-view breakfast, Italian fine dining, stone-baked pizza, and boutique hotel accommodation.

aboutPage.subtitle: OUR STORY
aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.text:
Maison La Plage was established on the Yalıncak coast of Ortahisar, Trabzon to bring together Mediterranean and Italian cuisine with quality ingredients, handmade flavors, a seafront atmosphere, and boutique hotel comfort.

From handmade pastas, ravioli, and tortellini to stone-baked Neapolitan and Margherita pizzas, from sea-view breakfasts to steak frites and fresh seafood, we prepare every plate with the same care. Our goal is not just to serve food, but to provide our guests with an unforgettable restaurant, cafe, and hotel experience.

By uniting taste, quality, and hospitality, we aim to be the premier coastal destination in Yalıncak, Ortahisar, and Trabzon.
aboutPage.phil1Text: We bring our kitchen to life with the freshest ingredients selected from local markets every morning.
aboutPage.phil2Text: We support eco-friendly production processes and protect the future of our seas.
aboutPage.phil3Text: We present artistic plates by blending Italian culinary traditions with modern techniques.
